description: One line at session start naming this pack's skill, so it is found without relying on description matching.

args: The React Native expertise pack is enabled in this repository. Its `mobile-react-native:react-native` skill has reference notes on Expo and bare builds, upgrades and the New Architecture, native modules, architecture and navigation, storage, testing, performance, and release with over-the-air updates. The notes carry dated version facts and traps that general knowledge often gets wrong; the skill says which note matches a task.
